title: Contact page: choose the structure
question: The world is settled (Carbon Order Pad). Pick how the contact page is composed, or re-roll.

options.label: Your Request, In Carbon
options.lineage: duplicate order pad: you keep the pink copy
options.thesis: A two-line order slip; sending it drops out your carbon-copy receipt with a reply-by stamp.
options.viewport: Carbon field. Start side: headline and one-hour promise. End side: the white slip with name and phone form lines and a big send button; WhatsApp and phone as tear-off tabs under the slip.
options.risk: The receipt moment only exists after submit; before that the page must still feel alive.

options.label: Three Ways, Ranked
options.lineage: printed price list next to a pad
options.thesis: Carbon side ranks the ways to reach Itay by speed; paper side holds the form.
options.viewport: Half carbon, half paper. Carbon: WhatsApp (minutes), phone (now), form (within the hour) as big numbered lines. Paper: the form with ruled lines and send.
options.risk: Ranking channels can pull people away from the form, which feeds the CRM.

options.label: Pick Your Callback
options.thesis: Name, phone, and a tap on a printed time strip: when should Itay call?
options.viewport: Paper page styled as the day's appointment book: time strip across the top (today / tomorrow slots), form lines beneath, circled slot in red ballpoint, send slip.
options.risk: An extra choice before sending can lower completions; slot times must not promise availability that is not real.
